description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the office of the Member of the Kataragama Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Kataragama Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely under the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
